nativeBrowserExecution.reportLimitationsNote: The drive writes fixed limitation sentences for its default local-preview mode. In this run ZODIACS_TEST_BASE_URL was https://zodiacs.org, so its pages, scripts and worker came from canonical production.

limitations: Anonymous GET requests and one headless Chrome session from one machine; no account, private birth data or protection bypass.
The local build ran with the feature flags unset, as Site Check builds; production builds with its own flags, so a chunk that embeds a flag or a public key can differ without a source difference.
Synthetic and public demonstration chart inputs only. Sampled at one-second resolution, as the UI says; no new accuracy measurement and no interval proof.
